events.title: We're partnering with Silver Lining Interactive!
events.summary: Hi everyone, we’re incredibly excited to finally share that we’re officially partnering with Silver Lining Interactive to publish The Road of Dust and Sorrow. Finding the right publishing partner was really important to us. We wanted to work with a team that understands indie development, respects creative vision, and genuinely cares about bringing unique games to the right audience. events.title: We hit 30,000 whishlists! 🎉
events.summary: Just a week ago, we announced our game — and today we’re already at 30,238 wishlists! This is an incredible milestone, and we’re beyond proud and grateful to have received so much support from all of you.Thank you so much for adding our game to your wishlists and for believing in what we’re creating. ❤️We’ll keep sharing updates as development moves forward — stay tuned for more!

events.title: Hello World!
events.summary: Hey everyone!Our store page for The Road of Dust and Sorrow is officially live on Steam!There are still things to be done with the game — we’re about halfway through the development — and there’s a long road ahead. But this moment feels huge. Until now, it was just our team and project, quietly moving forward. Now it’s out there, with a place of its own on Steam.❤️

basic_info.short_description: Road of Dust and Sorrow는 90년대 고전 게임에서 영감을 받아 탄생한 긴장감 넘치는 스토리 중심의 픽셀 아트 호러 게임입니다. 모든 것이 무너진 세계에서 살아남고, 당신에게 가장 소중한 존재인 딸을 지키세요.
